name: jev-firewall
description: A real-time firewall for AI coding agents: every tool call is checked (deterministic rules + the Jev decision model) before it reaches your machine. One command wires it into Claude Code and Codex.
author: Koushik Dey

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/smoke.test.js dist/test/codex.test.js dist/test/adversarial.test.js dist/test/grammar.test.js dist/test/jev-model.test.js dist/test/setup.test.js
